text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.title: Smart Auto Attack
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.a: DEFAULT: attack on full cooldown. FIXED_INTERVAL: attack every X ticks/seconds. RANDOM_INTERVAL: attack every random X-Y ticks/seconds.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.i: Ticks (20/sec) or seconds, for the interval values below.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.r: On (default): only attack a crosshair target. Off: swing blindly every interval, bypassing the blacklist/whitelist.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.a: FIXED/RANDOM interval only. On (default): still wait for full cooldown before swinging. Off: attack strictly on interval, risking weaker hits.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.n: Only attack at night. Useful for AFK-farming Creakings. Hidden while Throttle is on.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.s: On: Night only no longer applies in the Nether/End (no real day-night cycle there anyway).
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.f: Night only, pauses the max-duration timer during the day so it only counts night time.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.a: On: while your crosshair is on a Creaking, temporarily switches to the ideal Creaking setup (100-tick interval, night only) without changing your saved settings. Announces when it kicks in/reverts.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.t: On: alternates attacking/pausing for the durations below. Takes priority over Night only; see the guide for details.
e.g. '90m', '1.5h', '1h30m'. How long each attacking phase lasts before pausing.
e.g. '90m', '1.5h', '1h30m'. How long each paused phase lasts before attacking again.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.f: Freeze duration timer during throttle pause
On (default): pauses the max-duration timer during a throttle pause.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.m: Stop before durability drops below this absolute value.
Stop before durability drops below this percentage.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.u: On: switch to another matching weapon in the hotbar instead of stopping when durability runs low.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.t: How replacements are picked. KEYWORD: item ID contains the keyword below. SAME_TYPE: same weapon category, any material. EXACT_MATCH: identical item only.
KEYWORD mode only. e.g. 'sword' matches any *_sword.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.h: On (default): auto-disable if hunger drops below the threshold below.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.i: On: skip the hunger safety stop entirely while you have Regeneration (e.g. near a beacon).
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.h: On (default): react once health drops below the threshold below - stop, or pause-and-eat if the option below is on.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.e: Off (default): the health safety stop above just auto-disables. On: instead, pause (incl. all timers) and force-feed from Auto-eat until hunger is full, then wait for health to climb 2 hearts above the threshold before resuming. Gives up after 45 seconds. Needs an auto-eat food source configured.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.i: On: skip the health safety stop/pause entirely while you have Regeneration (e.g. near a beacon).
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.p: Off (default). On: don't fully trust Regeneration - still pause-and-eat when triggered even while regenerating, so hunger never goes untended. Needs Eat to regenerate health and Auto-eat both on.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.f: BLACKLIST: attack anything except the list below. WHITELIST: only attack the list below.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.e: On: never attacks any boat/raft/chest-boat/chest-raft or minecart variant, even if not on the list above.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.f: How to notify you of toggles/auto-stops.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.p: On (default): play a sound whenever the mod auto-stops itself.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.r: Off (default): a manual reconnect turns the mod off. On: it resumes automatically.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.a: On (default): auto-eat is active. Off: never eats automatically.
Off (default): only eat from the slot below. On: eat the first eligible food anywhere in the hotbar.
1-9. Ignored when Search any hotbar slot is on.
Start eating once hunger drops below this (0-20).
EAT_ONCE (default): one bite per dip below the threshold. DONT_OVEREAT: keep eating without wasting nutrition past 20. FILL_HUNGER: keep eating to a full bar, regardless of waste.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.f: LIGHT (default): blocks golden apple/pufferfish. FOOD_INSPECTOR: also rotten flesh/spider eye/raw chicken/poisonous potato. RAT: no extra blocks.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.p: Type an exact saved preset name, then Save & Done to apply it. Leave blank to do nothing. Takes effect after any other changes on this screen.
Type a name and Save & Done to save the current settings (including any other changes on this screen) as a new/overwritten preset. Leave blank to do nothing.
Type an exact saved preset name, then Save & Done to delete it. Leave blank to do nothing.
